STM32H5.evidence: Pinned ST fork c8d973bd contains native stm32h5x target config and flash driver; packaged PLASMA upstream runtime 9ea7f3d does not contain H5 support.
STM32H5.next_gate: Qualify ARMv7 build/package execution, Plasma FPGA SWD adapter compatibility, approved read-only real-target ID/flash-bank probe, then Programming/Electrical Profiles before erase-program-verify.

STM32C5.evidence: Pinned ST fork uses stldr; source loader table is empty and retained research records Tcl scalar/array lookup defects. Loader deployment, redistribution review, RAM compatibility and real-target qualification remain incomplete.
STM32C5.next_gate: Correct and qualify the bounded stldr runtime path with content-locked loaders, licensing review, ARMv7 packaging and read-only target evidence before any Production mapping.

STM32N6.evidence: PLASMA packaged upstream OpenOCD commit 9ea7f3d has no tcl/target/stm32n6x.cfg; pinned ST fork c8d973bd also has no stm32n6x target config.
STM32N6.next_gate: Admit a separately pinned flash-capable provider/runtime only after source, packaging and target-programming capability evidence exists.

STM32WB0.evidence: Neither packaged upstream OpenOCD commit 9ea7f3d nor pinned ST fork c8d973bd contains tcl/target/stm32wb0x.cfg.
STM32WB0.next_gate: Find an authoritative programmable backend and qualify it as a versioned provider; do not infer compatibility from other STM32 wireless families.

STM32WL3.evidence: Neither packaged upstream OpenOCD commit 9ea7f3d nor pinned ST fork c8d973bd contains tcl/target/stm32wl3x.cfg.
STM32WL3.next_gate: Find an authoritative programmable backend and qualify it as a versioned provider; stm32wlx support must not be generalized to WL3 without explicit evidence.
